d:
Stephen Curry keeps lighting it UP! Curry put up 41 points, 6 rebounds, 6 assists and 5 three-pointers, extending his streak of games with at least 5 made threes to five straight (Oct. 28–Nov. 7). It’s the eighth such streak within a single season of his career—twice as many as any other player in NBA history! Watch the highlights from another huge night for Steph!
With his performance tonight, Stephen Curry recorded his 16th career regular season game with 40+ PTS at age 35 or older
He passes LeBron James (15) for the most such games in NBA history
